sourceChanges.reason: Every number renderer caller frees inttostr output. Original zero returned a static literal, so initial score0/timer0 caused Android tagged-pointer abort. Allocate two bytes for zero and retain the original sprintf digits and all rendering. Also correct the random-line range from0..2995 to1..2995 for the pinned2995line dictionary, preventing a freed-buffer return at random index0.
